steps: Press the tip of your dominant index finger lightly against your lips.
Hold the hand with the palm facing your non-dominant side, left if you are right-handed.
Push the finger straight forward several inches in one quick, firm motion.
Keep the finger stiff and the movement short and decisive, like tapping the air.
Pair the motion with a confident nod and steady, direct eye contact.
tip: Think of shooting the word forward from your lips — one sharp push says you are sure.

steps: Curl both hands into firm S fists, with your thumbs tucked across your fingers.
Hold the fists in front of your chest about shoulder-width apart, palms facing inward.
Drive both fists straight downward about six inches in one firm, single motion.
Keep the drop short and confident — stop cleanly at the bottom of the movement.
Use a stronger, sharper push when you want to stress extra certainty.
tip: One firm drop means CAN or ABLE; repeating the motion shifts it toward POSSIBLE.

steps: Shape your dominant hand into a U, with the index and middle fingers extended together.
Touch the tip of your index finger to the side of your nose, palm facing down.
Hold your non-dominant hand out flat in front of your chest, palm facing down.
Sweep the dominant hand off your nose and land it on top of the flat hand.
Make the whole movement quick, light, and playful — a single smooth pass.
Do not linger at the nose; one clean trip from nose to hand completes the sign.
tip: FUN takes two hands and one quick motion — the one-handed nose-brush done twice is FUNNY instead.

steps: Close both hands into fists, the S handshape, with your thumbs resting across your fingers.
Cross your wrists over your chest, with both palms facing inward toward your body.
Pull both fists outward and apart from the chest in one smooth motion.
Rotate the fists as they separate so the palms finish facing outward.
End with your arms slightly open at your sides, relaxed and steady.
tip: Crossed fists breaking open outward — the same production covers safe, rescue, and free from harm.
